replacements.old:
Did Robert Pattinson marry Suki Waterhouse?

Still not officially confirmed as of July 2026 — but the rumors intensified when Pattinson was asked on the March 2026 red carpet for The Drama what the biggest secret he's ever kept was, and replied to Zendaya, "It's the same one that you have" — widely read as him hinting at a secret marriage to Waterhouse, not anything romantic between Zendaya (who has her own separate marriage rumors involving Tom Holland).
Zendaya's stylist Law Roach has publicly claimed at both the SAG Awards and the Oscars that "the wedding has already happened." Pattinson and Waterhouse have been engaged since around 2023 and share a daughter, born 2024.
replacements.new:
